Interface DataChangeValueEvent<V>

Type Parameters:
V - The value type being changed
All Superinterfaces:
IEvent
All Known Subinterfaces:
DataChangeValueEvent.Post<V>, DataChangeValueEvent.Pre<V>
All Known Implementing Classes:
DataChangeValuePostEventImpl, DataChangeValuePreEventImpl
public interface DataChangeValueEvent<V> extends IEvent
A Cyrus event that is triggered when a DataHolder changes one of its value. This will not trigger if a change has been requested but the change was rejected or both the original and the changing value are the same. As a result both before() and after() are nullable, but will never be that both are nullable

Note: The event system does not nor will ever be generic aware. While this event does have a generic, this is more for guenteeing the type of before() and after() are of the same value type. Intended to be used with the generic being attached to the function 

public <V> void handle(DataChangeValueEvent <V> event){
}

Note#2: If you are listening to this event as is, then you may find this event is triggering multiple times for the same change. This is due to DataChangeValueEvent.Pre and DataChangeValueEvent.Post being triggered. To fix the event firing multiple times then listen to one of the nested events.
